description: This file defines a TouchPad class used in Unity to handle touch input for a virtual joystick or touch-based control. It manages axes input, processes pointer events, and updates virtual axes accordingly.

classes.name: TouchPad
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class managing a touch-based virtual joystick/control element, supporting different control styles and axes options.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes virtual axes when the component is enabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Sets the image component and center position of the touch zone at startup.

methods.name: CreateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Creates and registers virtual axes based on configuration options.

methods.name: UpdateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Updates the virtual axes based on delta input, normalized.

methods.name: OnPointerDown
methods.description: Handles pointer down events by starting dragging and setting initial touch position.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes ongoing touch input, updating virtual axes accordingly.

methods.name: OnPointerUp
methods.description: Ends dragging and resets virtual axes when pointer is released.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Unregisters virtual axes when the component is disabled.
